checks.source_volume_uniqueness: each source_volume_id stored exactly once under source_cbct/
checks.leakage_constraint: all sample_id sharing a source_volume_id belong to one data_group_id
checks.PixelSpacing: 1 x 1 mm in 9,555 and 0.035 mm in 1,590 radiographs; retained but not used as an object-space scale
checks.crop_boundary_clipped: 52 of 2,229 crops retained fewer in-plane voxels; narrowest 64
checks.manual_anatomical_review: Two clinicians assessed 250 original pairs and 50 same-source substituted controls using the 90-degree view. First-submission label agreement: reader1 287/300 (95.7%), reader2 217/300 (72.3%); between-reader agreement 211/300 (70.3%). Subsequent unblinded author follow-up covered 91 cases: 89 between-reader disagreements and two shared deviations from the reference label. All 82 original pairs were judged approximately corresponding, and all nine controls non-corresponding. Author assessments agreed with reference labels in all 91 cases. See validation/anatomical_review/author_review_records.csv.
checks.crop_origin: provided for all 2,229 records; each verified by re-extraction from the released source volume
checks.crop_origin_verification: All 2,229 released crop arrays were compared with their recorded source-volume boxes within crop quantization tolerance; all boxes uniquely matched coordinate targets.
checks.source_volume_repaired: one source volume (sample rab_v184) had a missing slice restored before release. Its five crops were re-cut from the released 420-slice volume after that restoration, so they use the standard window (slices 160-300) and 0.25 mm isotropic spacing like every other crop.
checks.sha256: SHA256SUMS.txt lists all 14,767 current released files except itself (14,768 total).
checks.automated_correspondence_check: All 2,229 records freshly scored at five views against identical 20-candidate sets. Top1 [60,75,90,105,120] = [34.2,61.7,86.0,51.6,26.7]%; Top3 = [60.4,85.9,96.3,78.7,51.8]%. Current analysis: 2026-10-16; validation/multiview_retrieval/.

automated_correspondence_check_seeds.distractor_pool: same subset, drawn from the whole release
automated_correspondence_check_seeds.search_parameters_fixed_on: 255-record development half of a 511-record sample; included in the full-release results. Parameters were applied unchanged and not re-fitted for the full-release run.
automated_correspondence_check_seeds.angle_extension_parameter_selection: 80 queries, 20 per anatomical subset, from 445 records in fold 0; selected among 13 configurations. Complete candidate pool retained.

checks.automated_correspondence_check_scope: Full-release descriptive five-view retrieval including development records. All five angles were recomputed from current images. The current blinded study comprises 250 original pairs and 50 substituted controls at 90 degrees.
checks.coordinate_review: Within-observer repeatability was assessed using 2,244 paired photograph-derived detector-centre readings across 335 source volumes. The same observer read twice approximately one year apart, with first-session results concealed during the second session, and subsequently reviewed discrepant pairs. Agreement before review: median centre difference 0.50 mm, two-way mixed-effects, single-measurement, absolute-agreement ICC 0.990 (right axis) and 0.9997 (bottom axis); 63 records exceeded 2 mm and were reviewed by the same observer. 15 adjudications affected released records; 13 were applied after the automatic retrieval check confirmed an improved match, and 2 were reverted (the corrected window scored lower, or was indistinguishable) so that the released coordinates were kept. All 335 source volumes and all 2,229 crops remain 0.25 mm isotropic; the 2,216 crops whose coordinates were unchanged are byte-identical to the previous release. Initial adjudication proposed 16 changes: 15 concerned released records and one concerned an unreleased record. The current structured workflow export contains 46 retain_existing, 14 correct_to_new and 3 coordinate_uncertain decisions. Historical analysis retains the initial 44/16/3 counts. Current release crop-origin verification is reported separately from the preserved workflow flags.
checks.manual_pairing_qc: Series-level reconciliation, image-quality assessment and pairing check carried out by the authors over all 335 source-volume series, covering all 2,229 released records. The checklist offered a series verdict, a free-text note, and per-record and per-round flagging; every series was accepted and nothing was flagged at this step. Of the 2,244 coordinate targets, 15 did not enter the release, in 11 source volumes. The per-series record and the checklist are in validation/release_qc/manual_qc.csv and validation/README.md. Reviewer identity is recorded as the authors.

manual_pairing_qc_scope.mode: series-level reconciliation of ct_cut against x_ray rounds, per source-volume series
manual_pairing_qc_scope.series_with_orientation_operations_note: operations the review tool had queued, not operations present in the release; these seven series were never written back, and their released radiographs are byte-identical to the pre-edit copies

orientation_rotation_check.index_convention: Original coordinate-target ordinal, not retained-crop ordinal.
orientation_rotation_check.scope: Cumulative transform provenance, not independent anatomical orientation certification. Historical queued-operation counters are retained as historical annotations, not evidence of final applied transforms.

item_level.excluded_rounds: whole radiograph rounds dropped on export

manual_pairing_qc_scope.threshold_note: unlike the coordinate review's 2 mm criterion, no numeric threshold was fixed for this step; acceptance records that the reviewer did not reject a series, not the outcome of a test with a pass mark

review_duration.source: reviewed_at, set on every state change, so consecutive values bound time per series
review_duration.implication: bounds how far the series images can have been inspected; the step is reported as a curation pass, not as an image-quality validation whose discrimination the record demonstrates

coverage.note: All 2,229 released records have automated five-view ranks and series-level author quality inspection. The current blinded study displays 250 original pairs and 50 constructed controls.

manual_pairing_qc_scope.reviewer_identity_note: The public reviewer column contains the author-supplied role authors; no named or authenticated individual is recorded.
manual_pairing_qc_scope.quality_inspection_basis: Authors' account of qualitative five-view inspection; manual_qc.csv records source-volume-series decisions, not independent per-view quantitative scores.

checks.automated_correspondence_check_ci: Current Top-1 intervals: 4,000 partition-unit cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 20261016; fixed candidates. At 90 degrees: 86.0027% (1,917/2,229), interval 83.7267-88.2916%. See summary.csv.

dicom_uid_normalization.scope: UID, public-tag VR, file-meta, payload and decoding checks; not a full SOP Class IOD or PACS interoperability certification.

open_analysis_formats.scope: The workbook conversion counts below describe a historical preservation event. The workbook export itself is not distributed; current repeatability inputs and initial review decisions are supplied as CSV/JSON. Original scientific values and current release outcomes are unchanged.

checks.automated_correspondence_check_90_refere: The 90-degree slice of the current five-view analysis: Top-1 1,917/2,229 (86.0%); Top-3 2,147/2,229 (96.3%); score-discrimination AUC 0.962733. Filter validation/multiview_retrieval/per_record.csv on angle = 90.

1_coordinate_verification.decision_scope: The decisions field counts the current third_review_records.json export after two reversions. Initial adjudication counts are retained separately.

state_evidence.interpretation: Workflow downstream flags describe their recorded export, not the later full-release crop re-extraction. They have not been retroactively set to true.

1_coordinate_verification.status_scope: Complete for the published release; this does not mark all four historical workflow flags true or validate the one unreleased proposed correction.

basis_options.joint: Compatible joint morphology or relative anatomical relationships

author_followup.primary_materials: Panels A (90-degree radiograph) and B (CBCT maximum-intensity projection).
author_followup.interpretation: Descriptive unblinded author follow-up of all cases with at least one label-discordant or uncertain answer, separate from the blinded first-submission analysis.
author_followup.scope: At least one reader answer differed from the reference label, including uncertain responses.

3_anatomical_correspondence_review.previous_separate_study_status: Historical September study is outside the current publication package and is not pooled with this study.

documentation_reconciliation_basis.note: Current retrieval statistics recomputed from the 2026-10-16 scores. Top-1 intervals use partition-unit cluster bootstrap; previous full-release analyses are not distributed.
documentation_reconciliation_basis.coordinate_documentation_update: 2026-10-14: Current release summaries reconciled with the preserved coordinate workflow export and explicitly labelled historical analysis; no readings, per-record decisions, pixels or crop coordinates were changed.
documentation_reconciliation_basis.anatomical_review: Frozen first confirmed submissions of two clinicians plus a separate 91-case unblinded author follow-up table.

five_view_retrieval.ct_reference: Mean over the third array axis of crop[10:110,20:140,:]; percentile window 1-99.5; gradient NCC.

development.legacy90: Search variants developed on 255 records from a 511-record sample.
development.angle_extension: 13 configurations compared on 80 queries (20 per anatomical subset), drawn from 445 records in fold 0; chosen model angle_shift_axis1_factor1. Candidate pool uses the complete release.

five_view_retrieval.reporting: Full-release descriptive retrieval, no view fusion; per-view rank=1+number of distractors with strictly greater NCC.
five_view_retrieval.scope: Approximate anatomical correspondence; uncalibrated reference descriptor, not measured registration error. Five views are analyzed separately, not statistically independent experiments.
five_view_retrieval.provenance: All five angles freshly recomputed from current image bytes on 2026-10-16; no old scores or features used. 222,900 finite scores; original angle-first numerical verification passed. Only the current full-release analysis is distributed.

report.uid_method: UUID-derived 2.25 decimal identifiers; one-to-one SOP and original-Series mapping
report.originals_backup: Original pre-normalization published DICOMs retained by the authors outside the release; they are orientation-standardised exports, not the original acquisition exports.
report.scope: UID, public-tag VR, file-meta, payload and decoding checks; not a full SOP Class IOD or PACS interoperability certification.

metadata.provenance: Curated record selection and biological IDs are explicit input annotations. Crop boxes and derived fields recomputed from coordinate TXT and source headers.

coordinates.scope: Unique coordinate-to-record box reproduction; does not measure anatomical registration error.

crops.scope: Scaled voxel reproduction within crop quantization tolerance; array-space boxes, not pixel-to-voxel anatomical registration.

partitions.allocation: Frozen published unit IDs/folds replayed from explicit allocation inputs; grouping computed from record links. No claim to recover an undocumented original randomization seed.

files.preserved_fields: Stable IDs, roles and QC notes are read from the published annotation tables; bytes, hashes and imaging-header/decode checks are regenerated.

normalization_replay_spot_check.scope: Historical event replay; requires pre-normalization exports, which are not claimed to be raw detector frames or included in the public release.

report.bootstrap: 4,000 partition-unit cluster resamples; seed 20261016; conditional on fixed candidate sets and linkage metadata.

partition_overlap_check.scope: All ten pairs of the published five folds. Counts are CSV strings; original_csv_utf8 preserves the exact original CSV text including line endings.

report.scope: The original scoring-input table and timestamps remain unchanged. Current whole-file hashes for the 115 newly identified DICOM instances differ only because of UID/provenance headers. Exact PixelData and decoded arrays are unchanged; no new image analysis or anatomical review is implied.

validation_layout.coordinate_difference_definition: Euclidean distance between paired detector-centre coordinate readings, converted from cm to mm.
validation_layout.historical_archive_status: Historical archives and supporting code removed from the data package; current validation evidence remains in the four validation directories. Supporting code is in the versioned GitHub archive.
